credentialHandling: Runner supplies scoped credentials in memory. Never put keys, Authorization headers, operator tokens or private runtime configuration in artifacts.
executionRules: Run serially once with a fresh unique Idempotency-Key per active case. Disable automatic HTTP/SDK retries.
Preflight the exact deployed revision, current key-scoped model limits and visible price contract before inference. A changed revision or limit requires requalification of the affected assertions.
Stop on timeout, transport failure, unexpected status, missing request ID or unsettled receipt. Reconcile that request before any further inference; do not replace its idempotency key and resend.
The explicit duplicate and conflict checks are intentional refusals after readiness has settled; they reuse its original key. They are not extra authorised successful inference calls.
No account, key, billing, provider approval or deployment mutation is part of this file. Skip credential-state checks when the runner has no authorised matching test credential.

expected.selectedModelPricing: Require visible AUD contract-2 pricing at the key's own audience/basis; do not treat withheld or wholesale-only pricing as customer pricing.

ledgerReadback.accounting: Record exact string chargedNanoAud/reservedNanoAud, units, rateVersion and audience/basis. Missing or withheld amounts mean billing acceptance is unproven; never substitute zero.

validation.protocol: Require HTTP200 text/event-stream, nonempty x-request-id, consistent chat.completion.chunk id/model, assistant role, exactly one stop finish, a terminal usage frame with choices:[], and final data: [DONE]. Reject error frames, tool calls, missing terminal usage/DONE or truncated transport. Parse frames across arbitrary network chunk boundaries.
validation.ledger: Apply commonSuccess.ledgerReadback only after terminal DONE; reconcile unknown outcomes without replay. HTTP200 or partial OK text alone is not success.

optionalFollowups.activation: Specification only; requires separate root review after initial acceptance. Require tools capability on the scoped fast route and enough remaining authorised budget. No JEV routing or external tool execution.

negativeCases.prerequisite: readiness is settled; reuse its exact explicit Idempotency-Key and active QA credential, but change only the message body.
negativeCases.readback: Apply the same unchanged original-receipt and scoped ledger assertions as the identical-repeat case.

negativeCases.prerequisite: Use only an authorised fictional test key already expired, not revoked, whose secret is legitimately available in runner memory. Do not forge a key, alter clocks, mint or resurrect one from this specification.
After separately authorised QA-key cleanup, use that just-revoked key once while still in runner memory. Do not revoke a user/customer key for this test.

limits: Prepared test cases only; no API calls, live results or spend are recorded here.
Successful direct API tasks do not prove RealBud desktop/Hermes, bank login, email ingestion, calendar writes, separate offices, team joining or native Windows acceptance.
Refusal HTTP status alone does not establish no double billing; use request identity and authorised scoped ledger/charge readback.
No maximum wall-clock response time or price is invented; record elapsed time and exact ledger amounts from any authorised run.
Expired project-key refusal is distinct from expired tenant/service eligibility, which is 403 service_unavailable.
